# timezone

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:timezone`](gmeow-timezone.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/timezone>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An IANA time-zone identifier for a location (e.g. "America/Edmonton"). Non-functional: a large place may span several zones.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for an IANA time-zone identifier on a location; non-functional, so a large place may span several zones.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the civil-time-zone overlay as a regulated area (model that as a [`gmeow:RegulatoryOverlay`](../classes/gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md) of type [`gmeow:overlayTypeCivilTimeZone`](../individuals/gmeow-overlayTypeCivilTimeZone.md)) and avoid asserting one zone for a multi-zone country.

### How to use

- Add one or more [`gmeow:timezone`](gmeow-timezone.md) literals to the [`Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md); multiple zones coexist for a spanning place.

### Examples

- ex:edinburgh [`gmeow:timezone`](gmeow-timezone.md) "Europe/London".
